name: Light Pillar
doc: Light Pillar (enemy attack 308, Omega Weapon's and Ultima Weapon's): the GF cinematic engine's clone run from the two script files (mag219_b.00 / .01, its parameters) - its bones, prims, sprites and particles, the action results. The program calls the clone's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one clone at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag220_light_pillar.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).
